status: frozen before archive download or timeseries value access

source.title: 4th Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge: Dwarf Tomato Timeseries and Images
source.reported_scope: 2024 two-month cultivation; six 96 m2 compartments; five-minute greenhouse climate, control state, weather and plant measurements

purpose: Determine whether the public archive contains sufficient exogenous inputs, realised equipment states, facility metadata and crop initialisation variables for a prospective GreenLight trajectory validation without using indoor climate outcomes to select identities or periods.
allowed_before_validation_contract_is_fr: file names, directory names, compressed and uncompressed sizes, checksums and MIME types
table headers, declared units, documentation and data dictionaries
requested setpoints and realised equipment/control-state values and their missingness
resource inputs, irrigation, crop-management and non-climate plant measurements and their missingness
facility geometry, equipment specifications, sensor metadata and calibration descriptions
forbidden_before_validation_contract_is_: indoor relative-humidity, humidity-deficit, vapour-pressure or VPD values
any statistic, plot, missingness-based period selection or model residual computed from those outcome values
selection_rule: Candidate validation identities and periods may be selected only from timestamp continuity, compartment identity and completeness/range of allowed input fields. Outcome columns may be named in the schema but their values must not be parsed.
feasibility_questions: Are outdoor weather drivers present at an alignable interval?
Are realised heating, ventilation, screening, fogging/humidification, CO2 dosing and lighting states present rather than only requested setpoints?
Are units and sign conventions documented?
Are facility geometry, equipment capacities and sensor locations/calibrations reported?
Are crop state or management measurements sufficient to initialise LAI/transpiration assumptions?
Do input-complete continuous sequences exist without selecting on indoor outcomes?
Which required physical fluxes remain unmeasured and would need reconstruction or uncertainty bounds?

decision_categories.A: sufficient for prospective observed-action climate replay and candidate blind validation
decision_categories.B: usable only after source-grounded input reconstruction with frozen uncertainty bounds
decision_categories.C: usable for descriptive realism or development, not strict trajectory validation
decision_categories.D: insufficient even for aligned observed-action replay

next_freeze_before_outcome_access: A validation contract defining identities, periods, initial-condition access, model version and hashes, metrics, thresholds, missing-data rules and one-shot handling must be committed before any forbidden outcome value is read.
